admission.justification: Source comments, the plugin adapter, fixture labels and process-stop description jointly date the compatibility claims; relabeling a pin as a runtime confirmation would mislead later upgrades into trusting an unexercised display or message path.

applicability: Version attribution in host and plugin source explanations and in source-derived fixtures, when a build moves its host pin.
conditions: A sentence names the release actually examined for its claim; a confirmation repeated on the new release moves to 0.12.0, and one that was not repeated keeps its version.
Package and source inspection, a visible chat, a recorded assertion and an actual message-route observation stay distinct claims.
exclusions: No browser-test claim is recorded on 0.12.0 that the sandbox did not make.
No host-kink removal or model-catalog availability is inferred from the version move.

evidence: R8 closeout, new freeze (base 120fc025b740e57522d1c1189cdd63524f6543f0, tree 64e80014cd836e724fec2d9bd845b3454ec46a51, change 66521585be77e1b61d5ab5ddf4c76b83462009c860823778853d3b977fbb9adb; ONE comment sentence in client/bridge.ts:273, no behavior). F04 three lines added as record (each unchanged; bridge lines own-read, release anchors from architect check). F02 seen-not-asserted; F06 not met (pin lands without). Review complete, no sixth round (architect own check, D208).

statement: A sentence that names the host version names the release actually examined for its claim: a confirmation repeated on the new release moves to 0.12.0, a confirmation that was not repeated keeps the version it was confirmed at, and every such sentence names the kind of evidence behind it.
